name: cadherin 1

function.text: CDH1 encodes cadherin-1 [Cleaved into: E-Cad/CTF1; E-Cad/CTF2; E-Cad/CTF3]. Annotated molecular activities include cell adhesion mediator activity and ankyrin binding. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and cell migration.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to CDH1-related diffuse gastric and lobular breast cancer syndrome (autosomal dominant); blepharocheilodontic syndrome 1 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Gastric adenocarcinoma; Invasive lobular carcinoma of breast. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
